panel.note: Real Factori Japan mobility. Retail footfall/paths and tourism flows are derived from the panel; revenue is modelled and the SNS series is synthetic.

caveats: Mobility is real (Factori Japan panel); SNS is synthetic and tenant revenue is modelled from visits × assumed spend.
Panel estimates, not census; read patterns over absolute counts.
This is a domestic resident panel, so tourism is domestic (origin region), not inbound by nationality.
Airport retail zones are geographic terminal sub-areas, not individual tenants; GPS resolves the terminal, not floors or shops.
Every exported cell is suppressed below 5 distinct devices.
